question: Implementation target: step 10 of the loop at :11148 requires updating the benchmark so the same failure cannot silently return. Enforce it structurally: a defect record cannot move to CLOSED until a case exists whose oracle FAILS on the pre-fix commit and PASSES on the post-fix commit. Both runs must be recorded. A test written after the fix and never run against the broken state proves nothing, which is the ordinary way this requirement is satisfied on paper and violated in fact.
